data.value: Shows how fast or slow operations are running across the website and admin panel. Use this to identify slow pages, services, or external integrations. For business and order data, check the Reports menu.

data.name: MetricsHelpBullet1
data.value: Data is stored in-memory on the server and resets when the application restarts.

data.name: MetricsHelpBullet2
data.value: Durations are in milliseconds (ms). 1000 ms = 1 second.

data.name: MetricsHelpBullet3
data.value: The Explain button on each row translates the numbers into a plain text summary.

data.name: MetricsHelpBullet4
data.value: When evaluating performance, focus on percentiles (P50 → P99) rather than simple averages.

data.name: MetricNameHelp
data.value: The measured operation. Prefixes vary by type (controller:, service:, http:, db:).

data.name: CountHelp
data.value: How many times this operation has been invoked since application start.

data.name: ErrorHelp
data.value: How many of these calls resulted in an error.

data.name: AvgDurationHelp
data.value: Average duration of all calls. Can be skewed by outliers.

data.name: P50Help
data.value: 50th percentile (median). Half of calls were faster than this duration.

data.name: P75Help
data.value: 75th percentile. 75% of calls completed faster than this duration.

data.name: P90P95P99Help
data.value: Higher percentiles: 90% / 95% / 99% of calls finished faster than this duration. P95 is used for regular tracking; P99 for rare slow spikes.

data.name: PercentileExplanationNote
data.value: “P” stands for percentile. It indicates what percentage of requests were faster than that threshold.

data.name: InterpretBullet1
data.value: Low P50, high P99 → mostly fast with occasional spikes.

data.name: InterpretBullet2
data.value: High P50 / P95 / P99 → operation is universally slow.

data.name: InterpretBullet4
data.value: Low count → sample size too small for reliable percentiles.

data.name: InterpretBullet5
data.value: Click Explain on each row to read a tailored performance summary.
